picks.headline: AWS Open-Sources Deep Insight Framework for Production Multi-Agent Systems
picks.why: AWS has released an open-source framework designed to address context engineering, business logic, and operational failures in production LLM agent deployments.
picks.title: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them

picks.headline: Decode-Time Provenance Binding Protects MCP Models From Indirect Prompt Injection
picks.why: This defense addresses steganographic tool outputs attempting indirect prompt injections across multi-agent systems using the Model Context Protocol.
picks.title: Agentic AI Defense: Decode-Time Provenance Binding for MCP

picks.headline: Data-Free TRACE Attack Reconstructs Unlearned Text From Model Weight Differences
picks.why: It demonstrates that approximate unlearning techniques in LLMs leave parameter differences that allow attackers to reconstruct supposedly deleted data.
picks.title: TRACE: Data-Free Text Reconstruction Attacks against Approximate Unlearning in LLMs

picks.headline: Cloud API Grant Ambiguities Prevent True Least-Privilege AI Agent Authorization
picks.why: Analysis of Microsoft Graph and Google APIs shows up to 33% of tasks lack a single minimum privilege grant, leaving agent authorizations vulnerable.
picks.title: Incomparable Minima in Agent Tool Authorization

picks.headline: Qwen3-Coder Geopolitical Alignment Traced to Weights and Surgically Removed
picks.why: Researchers proved that political alignment in coding models can be ablated directly from weight matrices without reducing coding performance.
picks.title: Bias in Qwen3-Coder Model

picks.headline: Aligning Rounding Locations Prevents BF16 LLM Reinforcement Learning Collapse
picks.why: Aligning training and inference rounding points in RoPE and SwiGLU eliminates RL collapse in BF16 without requiring custom kernels or new loss functions.
picks.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning

papers.headline: DATC Maps Reward-Model Gradients to Policy Logits for Token Credit Assignment
papers.why: Using reward model gradient directions to weight token updates improves RL policy alignment over standard GRPO without extra sampling.
papers.title: Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment with Reward-Model Gradients

papers.headline: Sparse Autoencoders Convert Neural AI Detectors Into Fully Auditable Classifiers
papers.why: Training SAEs on residual stream activations creates transparent AI text detectors using interpretable, auditable features.
papers.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders

papers.headline: Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding Accelerates LLM RL Post-Training
papers.why: Using a prompt-bound n-gram drafter built dynamically from recent rollout history significantly speeds up RL generation loops.
papers.title: NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
